capabilities: Transcribe audio files into Markdown notes with per-speaker timestamps
Generate template-based AI summaries backlinked to transcripts via Gemini
Edit Markdown summary templates with prompt and placeholder placeholders
Rename speakers across transcript bodies and frontmatter
Auto-create a VoxNote workspace folder with gitignore rules
disambiguation: Not an audio recorder; it transcribes audio files you already have, via external APIs.
extras: Relisted under a new id (voxnote) in v2.0.0; users of the withdrawn "Deepgram Meeting STT" listing must manually uninstall and reinstall, and re-enter API keys. Full placeholder reference and accuracy guide live in a separate FEATURES.md. Warns to obtain participant consent before recording, and notes free-tier Gemini requests may be used to train Google's models.
intentEvidence: Migrating from "Deepgram Meeting STT"? The plugin was relisted as VoxNote in v2.0.0 (id voxnote).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn meeting or interview recordings into per-speaker transcripts and structured summary notes.

relations.evidence: speech-to-text via Deepgram with per-speaker timestamps
an optional AI summary step via Google Gemini

requires.name: Deepgram Growth or higher plan for guaranteed Zero Retention

summary: Speech-to-text plugin that transcribes audio files via Deepgram into timestamped Markdown notes, with optional template-based AI summaries via Gemini.
